meta.title: DChat - Decentralized Messaging
meta.description: Private, secure, and censorship-resistant messaging powered by blockchain technology.

hero.headline: Messaging Without Boundaries
hero.description: DChat is a decentralized messaging platform that puts you in control. No central servers. No data harvesting. Just pure, encrypted communication.

items.title: End-to-End Encryption
items.description: Every message is encrypted with state-of-the-art cryptography. Only you and your recipients can read your messages.

items.title: Truly Decentralized
items.description: No central servers to hack or shut down. Your messages flow through a distributed network of validators.

items.title: Censorship Resistant
items.description: No single entity can block your communications. Speak freely without fear of censorship.

items.title: Lightning Fast
items.description: Sub-second message delivery powered by our optimized consensus mechanism.

items.title: Group Channels
items.description: Create public or private channels for communities, teams, or friends.

items.title: Self-Sovereign Identity
items.description: You own your identity. No phone numbers or email required. Just your keys.

steps.title: Generate Your Keys
steps.description: Create a cryptographic identity in seconds. Your private key stays on your device.

steps.title: Connect to the Network
steps.description: Join the decentralized network of validators spread across the globe.

steps.title: Start Messaging
steps.description: Send encrypted messages that only your recipients can decrypt and read.

security.headline: Military-Grade Protection
security.description: DChat leverages blockchain technology and advanced cryptography to ensure your communications remain private and secure.

cta.headline: Ready to Take Control?
cta.description: Join thousands of users who have already made the switch to truly private messaging.
